scope: Actual native GATT C and upstream init/memory/mode/strerror bodies, exact log strings, actual SVC144/165/181, callback payloads, all event IDs below128, handle bounds, MTU clamps, raw byte flags, R1 unconditional data requests, log modes/transitions and callback/log mutations
limitations: SVC replies, limitation records, callbacks and final log backends are controlled boundaries; no live SoftDevice or hardware behavior is established.
Only mapped contexts/events and bounded mutations are covered; invalid pointer faults, asynchronous races and full startup are separate gates.
Original compiler/link identity, byte identity and whole-image linking remain unproven.
